t: Math for Game Programmers: Juicing Your Cameras With Math

q.x: If Language A has an idea that exists at one point in space, which is the closest word in Language B that might be used to represent it? A Voronoi diagram is one possible way of illustrating it.

desc:
In this 2016 GDC session, SMU Guildhall's Squirrel Eiserloh explores the math behind a variety of camera behaviors including framing techniques, types and characteristics of smoothed motion, camera shake, and dynamic split-screen.

Register for GDC: http://ubm.io/2gk5KTU

Join the GDC mailing list: http://www.gdconf.com/subscribe

Follow GDC on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Official_GDC
